reason: Document A answers my belief that members have plenty of chains: in those 14 counties the nearest chain is more than 20 miles away. It also gives a concrete sign of risk, with two of the 38 pharmacies saying they will stop filling for plan members, and it offers invoices I can check and a meeting before May 1, which makes it hard to dismiss as the usual yearly complaint. Document B has unfilled placeholders, doesn't mention the chain distance, and its asks are vaguer, with no offer to back up its numbers.
